laws.stock: undressed: every clip on its own timeline, B_FRAME = its own length (the calibration)
laws.s140: loco family -> the rig's NATIVE clip + B_FRAME native (the hook); gesture -> SOURCE timeline (KeepSourceTimeline) + B_FRAME stock; the jump slot -> the idle alias on the SOURCE timeline (KeepJumpTimeline); a stand/walk/run/turn slot's gesture -> the rig's idle, native; rig 0 stock
laws.bframe_off: slots native, B_FRAME = the raw clip (leg T3's red, `selfdress law bframe off`); a gesture and the jump slot still on the SOURCE timeline (the timeline law is on)
laws.timeline_off: gesture and the jump slot -> the idle alias at its own native length (`selfdress law timeline off`: KeepSourceTimeline and KeepJumpTimeline both off)

engine_model: ProcessAnime exec forward: NextFrame (aspeed/16 per tick, frameDif carry) > min(outFrame, frameN - 1) -> AnimLoop (loop/palindrome, loopCount) else AnimStop (afHold freezes at the last frame; otherwise DefaultAnim -> the idle at frame 0)
ExecAnim: animFrame = inFrame (uncapped), frameN = GetCharAnimFrame(go, anim)
B_FRAME = GetCharAnimFrame(gCur.go, id): gCur is the object running the function
GetObjUID: 255 = gCur, 250 = controlUID, 251-254 = partyUID; InitObject uid 0 = the entry id
RunJumpAnimation: animFlag = afHold, window 0..jump0-1; RunLandAnimation: animFlag = 0, window jump1+1..255
dressed jump slot: ExecAnim(actor.jump = the idle alias), then KeepJumpTimeline: frameN = GetCharAnimFrame(go, netJumpSrc) for a gesture while the timeline law is on
reachability cannot tell KeepJumpTimeline on from off (the alias covers every stock jump window): its tick law is pinned against battlewire.jump_frame_n, not by these verdicts
